_note: Hand-curated, well-established gene/trait associations used for category search. Traits are polygenic and these are simplified summaries, not diagnoses.

Red hair, fair skin and freckling
Hair color, freckling and sun sensitivity
Hair thickness, sweat glands and tooth shape
Metabolism of ~25% of drugs (codeine, many antidepressants)
Severe reactions to abacavir and carbamazepine
